capability.summary: Count detect-secrets findings per scanned file
capability.description: Runs the detect-secrets CLI scanner against one supplied path and returns a filename-to-count map derived from the scanner's JSON results; secret values and finding metadata are not exposed.
capability.problem_space: Coarse secret-scanning triage for a file or directory when per-file finding counts are sufficient.

constraint.io_signature: Input: one filesystem path string; output: JSON success payload whose results object maps each reported filename to its number of findings.
accepted_inputs: a file or directory path accepted by the installed detect-secrets scan command
constraint.output_shape: Success is an object with status="success", tool="lib.detect_secrets", and results as an object mapping each filename reported by detect-secrets to its integer finding count. A caught subprocess launch, timeout, or JSON-decoding exception produces an object with status="error", tool="lib.detect_secrets", and message as the exception string, then exits with code 1.
limitations: returns only per-file counts, not secret values, line numbers, plugin names, or full finding records
uses the installed detect-secrets CLI and its default scan configuration with a fixed 60-second timeout
does not inspect the subprocess exit code or stderr before attempting to parse stdout as JSON
invalid JSON output, launch failures, and timeouts are returned through the wrapper's error envelope

output_contract.description: Per-file detect-secrets finding counts in the results object; no finding details or secret values are included.

json_schema.description: Native JSON representation only; no field or task-delivery guarantee.

negative_intents: retrieve secret values or detailed finding metadata
sanitize or remove credentials from source files
scan text supplied directly without a filesystem path
